PDF.js 6.3.289 — Mozilla Foundation

Prebuilt legacy display and viewer components from pdfjs-dist 6.3.289.
Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdfjs-dist/v/6.3.289
Project: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
License: Apache-2.0; see LICENSE and notices included with asset directories.

No installation or build step is needed. Keep the display library, worker,
viewer, and supporting assets on the same version when updating.
